[Authentication] 1. Login Manual - QA Test Plan and Feature Documentation

Issue type: QA-owned test plan / feature documentation
GitHub issue: #139
Module: Authentication
Feature: Login Manual
Current issue state: Closed
Prepared by: QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9
Project: Villume Admin

Executive Summary

This document defines the QA test plan for the manual login feature in Villume Admin. The feature allows a guest user to open the authentication dialog, enter an email/username and password, submit credentials to the authentication API, and continue to the correct account state after the backend response.

This is a test-plan documentation issue, not a defect report. Historical smoke-test evidence from previous runs is preserved under the Smoke Testing History section.

Latest Automation Video Evidence

  • Test run date: 23 July 2026

  • Suite: qa_testing/tests/test-plan/authentication/login_manual.spec.ts

  • Result: Passed, 5 tests passed

  • Video:

Feature Scope

In Scope

  • Opening the login dialog from guest navigation.
  • Login form visibility and required fields.
  • Email/username and password validation before submit.
  • Password show/hide toggle behavior.
  • Manual credential login through POST /v1/auth.
  • Verified account flow after successful authentication.
  • Unverified account flow that stores temporary token and redirects to welcome flow.
  • Welcome/incomplete profile account flow that redirects to user update flow.
  • Invalid credential handling and visible error message.
  • Timeout retry behavior.
  • Forgot-password entry point from the login form.
  • Google sign-in button availability inside the shared auth dialog.
  • Basic desktop, mobile, and Android responsive coverage.

Out of Scope

  • Full forgot-password testing. Covered by the forgot-password feature plan.
  • Full sign-up testing. Covered by the sign-up feature plan.
  • Google OAuth provider account creation and provider-side failures beyond button availability and frontend handoff.
  • Backend authentication service internals beyond request/response contract observation.
  • Security penetration testing beyond lightweight negative input and injection-string checks.

Entry Criteria

  • Test environment is reachable.
  • Login page or header login entry point is available.
  • Verified test user credential is available.
  • Invalid credential data is prepared.
  • Backend auth endpoint is reachable from the selected environment.
  • Browser cache/session state can be cleared or isolated.
  • Evidence recording is ready when executing manual or automated QA.

Exit Criteria

  • All P0 login test cases are executed.
  • No open Critical/P0 login defect remains.
  • Valid login reaches the expected authenticated user state.
  • Invalid login is rejected without creating a session.
  • Validation messages are visible and understandable.
  • Smoke history and latest evidence are documented in this issue.
  • Any new defect is linked from this test plan.

Test Strategy

Method Focus Planned Coverage
White Box UI structure, validators, button state, source-level auth wiring Verify fields, disabled state, password toggle, component/service contract.
Gray Box Frontend-to-backend integration with known valid/invalid states Observe /v1/auth request and response handling.
Black Box User-visible behavior without relying on code knowledge Validate happy path, negative path, random input, and session result.
Regression Previously working authentication path stays stable Re-run login smoke and critical auth cases before release.
Responsive Login dialog remains usable on supported viewports Desktop, small desktop, and Android/mobile sizes.

Main Flow

Step Actor Action Expected System Behavior
1 Guest user opens Villume Admin. Header or landing navigation is visible with Log in entry point.
2 User clicks Log in. Login dialog opens with email/username, password, forgot-password link, Google button area, and disabled Continue button.
3 User fills a valid email/username and valid password. Fields accept input and Continue button becomes enabled.
4 User clicks Continue. System sends authentication request to POST /v1/auth and shows loading state while waiting.
5 Backend returns verified account response. Token is stored/updated and user is redirected to the expected profile or source flow.
6 User reaches authenticated page/state. Profile URL/menu/session state confirms the user is logged in.

Alternative and Negative Flows

# Scenario Expected Result Priority
1 Submit empty form Continue remains disabled or required-field validation is shown after touch. P0
2 Password shorter than 6 characters Password validation message is shown and submit is blocked. P0
3 Invalid email/username or invalid password Login request is rejected and a "Login failed" error toast is shown. P0
4 Backend timeout Login logic retries the authentication request. P1
5 Unverified account logs in Temporary token is stored and user is redirected to /welcome. P1
6 Welcome/incomplete account logs in User is redirected to /user-update. P1
7 Login initiated from pricing page Successful login redirects according to pricing flow handling. P2
8 Login initiated from catalogue/create flow Successful login validates create eligibility and redirects to create/profile flow. P2
9 User clicks forgot-password link Login dialog closes and forgot-password dialog opens. P1
10 User toggles password visibility Password field switches between masked and visible text without changing value. P2

QA Tester Summary — Issue #139: [Authentication] 1. Login Manual

Verdict: PASS — no coding defect found in the manual authentication flow.

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/authentication/issue_139_login_manual_real_site.spec.ts (rerunnable automated suite)

Real-site environment: Production https://villume.com · Tester account jsy9 · 08 Sep 2026

Test Summary

# Method Scenario Expected result Confusion Matrix Result
1 White Box Inspect authentication modal DOM, input controls, and show/hide password toggle Dialog opens cleanly with #login-email, #login-pw, and submit button in disabled state until inputs are filled. Password toggle successfully flips input type between password and text. TP PASS
2 Gray Box Login with valid credentials (jsy9) and verify backend auth response contract POST https://app2.villume.com/v1/auth returns HTTP 200 with JWT token and user profile object. Application stores token and navigates to https://villume.com/jsy9. TP PASS
3 Black Box Authenticated user session state and profile UI verification Account menu button for jsy9 is visible and accessible. User gallery dashboard renders correctly without errors. TP PASS
4 Black Box Negative authentication validation with invalid credentials POST https://app2.villume.com/v1/auth returns HTTP 409 (status: CONFLICT, messages: "User Not Found"). PrimeNG Toast error displays "Login failed - User Not Found", dialog remains open, and session is not created. TN PASS
5 Regression Guard Injection & state isolation safety Negative inputs are rejected safely without script/query execution; local storage & cookies are isolated per context. TN PASS

Code Review

Area Evidence Result
Dialog structure & accessibility .authentication-dialog uses PrimeNG .p-dialog.v-dialog shell standards, conforming to global dialog rules without leaky styles. PASS
Form validation contract Submit button (button[type="submit"]) is strictly disabled when email/password fields are empty or invalid (< 6 characters), preventing invalid network dispatches. PASS
Password toggle safety Toggle button .input-toggle dynamically modifies DOM property type between password and text safely without mutating input value. PASS
State & token handling JWT auth token is securely stored and forwarded; user navigation directly targets active username slug (/jsy9). PASS
Error handling & toasts Backend error response (HTTP 409 Conflict) is properly captured and rendered via PrimeNG Toast (.p-toast-detail), retaining user context for correction. PASS

QA Tester Summary — Issue #142: [Authentication] 4. Logout

Verdict: PASS — no coding defect found in the manual logout and session termination flow.

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/authentication/issue_142_logout_real_site.spec.ts (rerunnable automated suite)

Real-site environment: Production https://villume.com · Tester account jsy9 · 08 Sep 2026

Test Summary

# Method Scenario Expected result Confusion Matrix Result
1 White Box Authenticate user and verify user menu popover DOM structure and sign-out button User avatar button (button.nav-user) renders in header, opens PrimeNG popover (.header-nav-user-menu), and contains red/destructive styled Sign out action (.header-nav-user-menu__item--danger). TP PASS
2 Gray Box Execute logout action and verify session cookie and storage clearance Clicking Sign out invokes CookieService.deleteCookie() for villume_token and support_token, navigates user back to https://villume.com/, and eliminates authentication tokens from storage. TP PASS
3 Black Box Verify unauthenticated header UI state and unauthenticated navigation Header returns to guest state displaying "Log in" and "Get started" buttons; account menu is removed from the DOM. TP PASS
4 Black Box / Regression Guard Protected route direct access restriction Attempting direct navigation to /settings/profile while signed out denies access and safely redirects to /404 or / without exposing user data. TN PASS
5 Regression Guard State isolation & storage cleanliness After logout, localStorage and sessionStorage retain no residual bearer credentials or user profile objects. TN PASS

Code Review

Area Evidence Result
Component & method ownership signOut() is cleanly encapsulated in header.component.ts, triggering this.clearSession() and closing the popover overlay. PASS
Cookie & session management CookieService.deleteCookie() properly invalidates cookies with UTC epoch expiration (expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;). PASS
Glitch-free browser redirect In browser context, clearSession() performs a clean page reload (window.location.href = '/') to clear all in-memory Angular signal/RxJS state without UI glitches. PASS
Styling & UX standards Sign-out action is styled with --danger modifier and distinct visual affordance, separated from profile/settings links. PASS
Route protection & guards Auth guards and route interception prevent unauthenticated sessions from reaching protected user settings. PASS
